title: Compressed audit onboarding path for enterprise customers
creator: Nora Alvarez
description: Create a compressed, repeatable milestone tracker and playbook to onboard high-priority enterprise customers for audit readiness (SOC2/ISO scope) focusing on SSO/SAML cutover, audit-log retention guarantees, and evidence handoff. Objective is to reduce average customer onboarding time from 8 weeks to 3–4 weeks for customers with existing SSO providers and to provide clear handoffs for audits.
milestones: Milestone 1: Evidence map & minimal required artifact checklist (week 1)
Milestone 3: Auditlog retention policy implementation and retention proof (week 2)
Milestone 4: Test customer onboarding (canary) + evidence packet review (week 3)
Milestone 5: Cutover plan and rollback playbook distributed to customer + internal ops (week 3–4)
Milestone 6: Post-cutover audit readiness signoff and runbook handoff (week 4)
Milestone 7: Metrics collection and retro; encode improvements into template (week 5)
Milestone 8: Scale template for next cohort and create automated reminders in Console (ongoing)
Milestone 9: Publish customer-facing checklist and legal attestation wording (release)
acceptance_criteria: Can onboard a staged enterprise customer end-to-end within 4 weeks using the playbook
All required evidence artifacts available in the evidence packet format and validated by Compliance SME
SSO/SAML end-to-end test (assertions, provisioning flow) passes in staging and prod sandbox
Auditlog retention verified for requested window (tenant-level proof available) and retrieval tested
Runbook published and linked from Console onboarding flow; metrics tracked for time-to-onboard
risks: Dependency on ENG tickets for auditlog retention backfill (ENG-22011) could slip
Enterprise customers with custom IdPs require extra validation or driver changes
Legal attestation wording may need counsel review and delay public docs
Edge-case retention retrieval performance could impact SLOs during evidence collection
